categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 01 - Drove Off Void Kong!
locations.description: **Location:** Right in front of you when you land in this layer.

locations.title: 02 - Buried in the Beach
locations.description: **Location:** Underground. Approach an eel on the western edge of the island, and it'll dig a tunnel right past this banana.

locations.title: 33 - Adrift at Sea
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a small stone island that's drifting around (so may not be in this exact spot in your game!)

locations.title: 04 - Checking into the Tropical Retreat
locations.description: **Location:** Next to the [Tropical Retreat](#loc=474478) checkpoint.

locations.title: 13 - The Resort Growtone
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for feeding 400 gold to the Growtone on the high-up island.

To reach it, use the Liftoff Ore to fly directly upwards. This will create more ore with the help of a Shifty Block, which you can take a chunk out of to fly up even further and reach the Growtone.

locations.title: 14 - The Hungry Resort Growtone
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for feeding 2000 gold to the Growtone on the high-up island.

To reach it, use the Liftoff Ore to fly directly upwards. This will create more ore with the help of a Shifty Block, which you can take a chunk out of to fly up even further and reach the Growtone.

locations.title: 15 - The Sated Resort Growtone
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for feeding 4000 gold to the Growtone on the high-up island.

To reach it, use the Liftoff Ore to fly directly upwards. This will create more ore with the help of a Shifty Block, which you can take a chunk out of to fly up even further and reach the Growtone.

locations.title: 42 - Resort Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for handing over 50 Banandium Chips in the [Chip Exchange](#loc=474507).

locations.title: 08 - Secret Beachside Grotto
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a cave beneath the surface of the cliffs.

locations.title: 05 - Resort Quiz Master
locations.description:
**Location:** Given to you by Quiztone, found on the sand. Answer the three questions correctly - answers listed below - to receive the banana.

- What does the Zebra Elder wear on his head?
    - Sunglasses
- What WON'T you find within the Eggshell Hotel?
    - A juice bar
- What WON'T you find on this layer?
   - Coconuts

locations.title: 19 - Shifty Smash: Liftoff to the Sky

locations.title: 35 - Quick Snack on Skydive Isle

locations.title: 40 - Above the Big Watermelon

locations.title: 24 - Bloomed in the Resort Layer
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by the plant pot creature when you destroy the concrete bananas blocking the light.

locations.title: 38 - Battle: Aerial Aiming

locations.title: 39 - Down from Skydive Isle

locations.title: 06 - Underground Runaround
locations.description: **Location:** Underground. After dropping through the [Cave Entrance](#loc=474640), follow the arrows as they guide you through some tunnels and down to where the banana awaits.

locations.title: 21 - At the Cannon Crossroads
locations.description: **Location:** On the floating island, reached via [Barrel Cannon](#loc=474646).

locations.title: 29 - Rising Seafloor Ruins
locations.description:
**Location:** In a pillar beneath the sea. To lift it up, break the cube-shaped strawberry on an island to the south and hit the punching bag.

You'll then have to navigate a Shifty Ore obstacle course to find the banana at the end.

locations.title: 36 - Skydive Isle's Side Pocket
locations.description: **Location:** Floating island - underneath the platform that the Shifty Smash Challenge is on top of.

locations.title: 37 - Shifty Smash: Floating Rotation
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=474669) on the floating island.

locations.title: 22 - Battle: Baited to a Bruising

locations.title: 03 - Strawberry and Banana
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath a cube-shaped strawberry on the floating island. Create a rainbow bridge to reach it.

locations.title: 09 - A Daring Drop
locations.description: **Location:** [Mine-Cart Country](#loc=474678) - let yourself fall through a hole in the rails that has three large clumps of gold above it to find this banana on the ground below.

locations.title: 10 - Rail-Ride Rest Stop
locations.description: **Location:** [Mine-Cart Country](#loc=474678) - At the end of the first set of rails.

locations.title: 11 - End of the Line

locations.title: 16 - Resort Fragmentone Recovery
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for reuniting the first Fragment with its body.

The closest one can be found [here](#loc=474684).

locations.title: 17 - Resort Fragmentone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for bringing [Fragment 1](#loc=474684), [Fragment 2](#loc=474686) and [Fragment 3](#loc=474689) back to their main body.

locations.title: 18 - Resort Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Speak to the 'Smashintone' on the platform after smashing 30,000 cubic metres of sand in this layer.

locations.title: 30 - Changing Lanes
locations.description:
**Location:** [Switch-Lane Skyway](#loc=474692) - after the first part of the obstacle course.

_Tip: when the paths move vertically, jump on top of them!_

locations.title: 31 - Clearing the Lanes
locations.description: **Location:** [Switch-Lane Skyway](#loc=474692) - at the end of the course.

locations.title: 32 - Pause for the Underpass
locations.description: **Location:** [Switch-Lane Skyway](#loc=474692) - stay on the moving paths you'd usually jump off to collect banana 31, and they'll continue extending into a secret room where this banana awaits.

locations.title: 07 - Up Means Down
locations.description: **Location:** Deep underground (reached via [Cave Entrance](#loc=474640)) - dig beneath a Fragmentone at the edge of the area that's pointing up.

locations.title: 20 - Cranky's Resort Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by Cranky Kong, found in a cave accessed through the water to the west.

locations.title: 23 - Shifty Smash: Seaside Smashing
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=474698) in the strawberry.

locations.title: 25 - Resort Hide-and-Seek
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for finding and hitting [Hiddentone 1](#loc=474659), [Hiddentone 2](#loc=474700), [Hiddentone 3](#loc=474660) and [Hiddentone 4](#loc=474701).

locations.title: 26 - Shaved-Ice Trainee
locations.description: **Location:** [Ice-Serve Switcheroo](#loc=474703) - reward for filling the first cup with shaved ice.

locations.title: 27 - Shaved-Ice Artisan

locations.title: 28 - Shaved-Ice Master
locations.description: **Location:** [Ice-Serve Switcheroo](#loc=474703) - reward for filling the final cup with shaved ice. Ignore the exit barrel - the third puzzle is behind a stone wall next to it.

locations.title: 34 - Floating Freebie
locations.description:
**Location:** On a floating island above the water. To reach it, attack an enemy at the end of a nearby pier (preferably towards the middle of the lake) and use the Liftoff Ore it generates to fly up to the island.

Alternatively, you can use a barrel that appears when you purchase the [Tropical Retreat Getaway](#loc=474511) and transform into an ostrich. When you reach maximum height, start flapping to reach the island.

locations.title: 41 - Decked Out In Dampness
locations.description:
**Location**: You'll find this Glamtone standing atop the Big Watermelon Memorial in the center of the map.

**Required Clothing**
- Aqua Blue Fur
- Soggy Cravat
- Swimmin' Britches
